# Vendor Alpha — Security Self-Assessment Report

## Company Overview

Vendor Alpha provides customer behavior analytics for enterprise retail
clients. This report is submitted as part of the vendor onboarding process
for evaluation against NexusIQ's security and procurement standards.

## Security Posture

Vendor Alpha maintains SOC 2 Type II certification, renewed annually. All
customer data is encrypted at rest using AES-256 and in transit using
TLS 1.3.

## Incident Response

Vendor Alpha commits to a 4-hour breach notification window for any
confirmed data incident affecting customer data.

## Data Handling

See the accompanying data processing addendum
(vendor-alpha-data-processing.md) for subprocessor and data-handling
detail; this report covers security controls only.
